meta.description: Verified clinical guideline snapshot for offline fallback (PRD FR-3.1). URLs captured Oct 2026 via MCP-verified searches. Live Tavily replaces these at runtime when a TAVILY_API_KEY exists.

snapshots.title: Fleischner Society 2017 Guidelines for Incidental Pulmonary Nodules (Radiology)
snapshots.snippet: For a solid nodule measuring 6 to 8 mm in a patient at low or moderate risk: perform initial follow-up CT at 6-12 months.

snapshots.title: KDIGO 2012 Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury
snapshots.snippet: AKI Stage 1: increase in serum creatinine >= 0.3 mg/dL (26.5 µmol/L) within 48 hours, or 1.5-1.9 times baseline within 7 days.

snapshots.title: FDA — Toradol (ketorolac tromethamine) labeling information
snapshots.snippet: Contraindicated in advanced renal impairment and in patients at risk for renal failure due to volume depletion; recommend avoiding in acute kidney injury.

snapshots.title: Managing Incidental Adrenal Masses: ACR Incidental Findings Committee
snapshots.snippet: For indeterminate adrenal nodules 1 to 4 cm with attenuation >10 HU, follow-up adrenal protocol CT (CPT 74170) or chemical shift MRI at 6-12 months is indicated.

snapshots.title: AHA/ACC Heart Failure Guidelines — Potassium and Mineralocorticoid Antagonists
snapshots.snippet: Aldosterone antagonists should not be initiated or continued in setting of rising serum potassium >= 5.0 mmol/L to avoid lethal arrhythmia.

snapshots.title: ACG Clinical Guideline: Management of Acute Occult Hemorrhage and Antithrombotic Therapy
snapshots.snippet: Discontinue NSAIDs and anticoagulants immediately in the presence of acute kinetic hemoglobin drops until source is definitively identified.
